notes.title: 19 Mar, 2018 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello!

Patch includes the following:
- Fixed jump sound not playing.
- Options are now saved.
- Fixed minor collision issues.
- Fixed Steam overlay issues.
- New save file location. (Previous save files are automatically moved to the correct location when launching the game)

notes.title: 1 July, 2017 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello people!

The new patch includes the following:

- Added feature that shows the controls for the robot arm next to it. This helps the new players to better understand the control scheme.

- The orb is a bit larger now which makes it easier to land on with Eli.

- Small enhancement to the result screen after beating a level.

- The difficulty in some levels has been nerfed.
